title: Report details text survives Cancel and shows in the next report
trigger: Open a report, reach the details step, type a comment, press Close; later report anything (any chat) up to the details step.
effect: The text area still holds the old comment, which is sent with the new report if the user does not notice. close_message_report never clears report_text (only a send does).
fix: Reset the text field in the single place that ends the flow (the ReportBox going back to Closed).

title: 'Blocked' toast is shown when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Block a Replies sender while TDLib rejects blockMessageSenderFromReplies.
effect: submit_replies_block sets the success note NEW_CONTACT_BLOCK_DONE as soon as send_json returned Ok; the error answer then sets chat_action_error (users/error.rs:110), so the user sees 'blocked' followed by 'could not block'. The session's replies_block was also take()n before the send (connect/replies_block.rs:10), so a failed send cannot be retried from the box.
fix: Keep the box in a Submitting stage until the answer; show the note on the answer.

title: Vote tap is matched to an option by position, not option id
trigger: Poll updates (an option added/reordered via addPollOption or updatePoll) between the frame that drew the row and the click.
effect: The click closure captures `index` and vote_on_poll(chat, message, index) resolves it against the poll as it is at click time, so the vote can go to a different option than the one the user clicked.
fix: Pass option.id (PollOption::id) from the row and have the driver look it up.

title: Most message-menu closes skip reset_message_reactions
trigger: Open the menu on a message, pick a row that does `this.message_ui.menu = None` (e.g. menu_media_rows, menu_gift_row, menu_block_sender_row, open_message_report) instead of close_message_menu.
effect: The session keeps message_reaction_options (Loading/Ready for the old message) and payments.paid.offered until the next open; a late answer lands for a closed menu. Next open refetches, so only a stale strip for one frame at worst.
fix: One close_message_menu used at all 52 sites, or tie the reaction request state to the OpenMessageMenu value.

title: Debug-build arithmetic overflow on negative (pending) message ids
trigger: Send a message so its local id is negative (message.id.0 < 0 exists, session_forward.rs:166); the row passes `message.id.0 as u64`.
effect: text_at computes `msg_key.1 * 2 + ..`, fast_button_cell `message_id * 10 + n`, poll_option_row `message_id.0 as u64 * 64 + index`: u64 overflow panics in debug/test builds (release wraps; Cargo.toml has no overflow-checks).
fix: Use wrapping_mul / a hashed id (or a MessageKey newtype with a checked element id) for element ids.

title: 'Load full message' has no in-flight state
trigger: Tap Load full message on a partial rich message twice, or when the request fails silently.
effect: The button stays live after the request is sent, so every tap sends another getFullRichMessage and a toast; nothing shows that the first is loading or ties the answer to the message that asked.
fix: A per-message Fetch<()> in the session (idle/loading/failed) that the button reads.

title: A previewed saved sound plays whenever its download ends
trigger: Press the play button on a saved sound that is not downloaded, close the settings, wait.
effect: The completion lands in pending_sound_plays and hand_out_notifications plays it unconditionally, long after the picker is gone, even when sounds are off or the user is in a call.
fix: Tie the pending play to the picker session (token) and drop it when the picker closes.

title: The ringing-call toast is tracked in one slot that is the account on screen's
trigger: Account A rings and is notified; switch to account B (or another call rings there).
effect: calls.notified holds one (account, call_id); announce_ringing_call dismisses it as soon as the account on screen has no ringing call, so A's still-ringing toast (with Accept/Decline) is withdrawn, and a second notified call overwrites the slot so the first is never dismissed.
fix: Track notified calls per account (map keyed by AccountKey), dismissed by the account that owns the call.

title: 'Mark as read' on a notification posted before the lock still runs while locked
trigger: Notification shown; lock Quill; press Mark as read in the OS toast.
effect: drain_background_clicks runs MarkRead without refused_while_locked, so read receipts are sent for a chat under the lock (tdesktop only shows the window).
fix: Gate MarkRead (and Reply) on the lock; keep the click queued until the unlock.

title: A withdraw can run before the toast it should close is registered
trigger: A chat is read on another device right after its message arrives (Linux D-Bus path).
effect: show() runs on a worker thread and records the id only after the Notify round trip; close() finds no id in Shown and returns Ok, then the toast appears and stays for a chat that was already read.
fix: Record 'withdrawn' for the key in Shown so show() closes what it just made.

title: The signal listener thread ends for good when the bus iterator ends
trigger: The session bus connection drops (bus restart) while Quill runs.
effect: listen() returns when MessageIterator ends and is never restarted; NOTIFIER stays set, so toasts still show but their clicks, Reply and Closed signals never arrive until restart.
fix: Reconnect (clear NOTIFIER and let the retry gate re-make it) when the listener ends.

title: File picked for a poll option lands on a row index that may have changed
trigger: Click the paperclip on row 3 -> Photo or video; while the native file panel is open (non-modal on some platforms) remove row 1 from the poll box; pick a file.
effect: take_poll_option_file(AttachTarget::Row(3)) attaches the media to whatever option is now at index 3 (or nothing), not the row that asked.
fix: Give each option row a stable id (OptionId) and target AttachTarget::Row(OptionId) so an answer is matched to the row that asked.

title: Quick-reply edit/add closes the edit state when the request is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Edit a message, Save, server rejects it
effect: Field is cleared and editing ends though the text was not saved; the server error is a generic line
fix: Hold the text in a Saving stage until the shortcut update arrives or fails.

title: Reply in Another Chat drops the reply when the destination chat is not opened
trigger: With an agent driving the window that may not open the destination, pick a chat in Reply in Another Chat.
effect: The reply is cleared from this composer before select_chat_request, which returns false on refusal (agent_may_open) without restoring it; the note still says replying from another chat.
fix: Take the reply only after the open succeeded, or restore it on a false return.

title: Rich-HTML export outcomes are polled only for the account on screen
trigger: Start Save as HTML in account A, switch to B before it ends
effect: The finished outcome stays in A's background driver; no toast until switching back, then a stale 'saved' toast
fix: Poll or drain outcomes per background account.

title: Validation messages sent as Silent notes are dropped while a toast is showing
trigger: Press Done with no emoji (EMOJI_REQUIRED_NOTE), or add to a full set, within 3-6 s of another toast
effect: ConnectionUi::set_note_in discards Silent notes while the current note is a toast; the user gets no reason why Done did nothing
fix: Use StatusNote::info for refusals the screen does not show by itself

title: Account switch leaves the set box's encode running and its editor files behind
trigger: Press Done on a video sticker, switch account
effect: OnScreen is replaced whole; the empty Farewell does not set the encode cancel flag nor call CreateSticker::discard, so ffmpeg keeps running to completion and the editor PNG/preview stay in temp
fix: Farewell calls reset()

title: The manager box shares the composer sticker panel's tab and open flag
trigger: Open the composer sticker panel on Favorites, then Settings > Manage sticker sets, close it
effect: open_archived_stickers sets the shared panel tab to Installed and close_sticker_panel closes the composer panel's state
fix: Give the manager its own tab state

title: In the masks box one pending change disables Add on every row
trigger: Press Add on one archived mask set
effect: mask_change_pending() is not keyed by set, so all rows show loading and disabled until the answer
fix: Key the pending test by set id as for stickers

title: Thread info card stays open when another thread opens in the same chat
trigger: Open a reply thread in a group, open the info card with the root bar's info button, press Back, open a different message's thread in the same group.
effect: thread_info_open is per ChatUi (chat), reset only by sync_chat_ui when the chat changes; the new thread of the same chat starts with the card already open.
fix: Key the card by thread id (Option<thread id>) or clear it in leave_thread_view / on thread change.

title: Retry on a failed thread open ignores a send error
trigger: Thread open fails, press Retry while the connection is down.
effect: retry_thread() sets threads.thread = None then open_thread; on Err the result is dropped with let _, so the failed pane disappears with no toast and the view is left on the chat with no explanation.
fix: Surface the Err as a StatusNote error (as open_thread_view does) and keep the Failed status.

title: Account switch leaves the open selection translation job in the old session
trigger: Open Translate Selected Text, switch account while the box is open or the answer is pending.
effect: TranslateScreen is dropped with the screen but its Farewell is empty, so drop_text_translation is never sent to the old client: the job stays in that session's translate.jobs (counts toward MAX_IN_FLIGHT for its pump) and texts keeps the result until the process ends.
fix: Implement Farewell for TranslateScreen: drop the dialog's job through the old client.

title: Hiding the translate bar claims success when the request was not sent, and falls back to an app-wide hidden flag by bare chat id
trigger: Bar menu -> Hide while toggle_chat_is_translatable returns Err (no usable client), or the server rejects it.
effect: set_translate_bar_hidden ignores the answer: on Err it stores prefs.bar_hidden(chat_id.0) in the app-wide translate_prefs.json (shared by all accounts, keyed by bare ChatId, so the same user's chat in another account is hidden too), and hide_translate_bar always shows the 'hidden' toast with Undo. On a rejected request the bar stays and the toast lied.
fix: Key local hidden flags by AccountChat and show the toast from the server answer (update chat.is_translatable) rather than from the send.

title: pump_translation reports 'changed' on every tick in a demo session when the bar is no longer offered
trigger: Screenshot demo (live is None): chat is translated and translate_bar_model becomes None (bar hidden, setting off).
effect: The None arm clears chat_to only through self.live, then returns true unconditionally; with no live client chat_to is never cleared, so every poll pass returns true and the poll loop redraws every tick.
fix: Return true only when chat_to actually changed (clear it on demo_session too).

title: Translation pump stops for the whole account if in-flight jobs are never answered
trigger: Twenty translateMessageText requests whose answers are lost (connection drop, dropped continuation).
effect: room = MAX_IN_FLIGHT - session.messages.translate.jobs.len(); jobs leave only when an answer or abandon_translation arrives. Stuck Pending jobs keep room at 0, so translated chats in every window stop translating new messages until restart.
fix: Give a job an expiry/owner (drop jobs of a closed connection) or count only jobs younger than a deadline on a manual clock.

title: A widget press or hover sticks when its bubble stops painting mid-gesture
trigger: Press on a widget message and scroll the history (wheel) so the bubble leaves the view before releasing, or switch chats while hovering it.
effect: The mouse-up/move handlers are only registered while the canvas paints, so entry.pressed stays Some and later moves reach the widget as a drag; entry.hovered stays true with no hover-leave.
fix: Release the press/hover when the widget is not drawn in a pass (the per-window seen pass already exists) or on window blur.

title: Canvases::read multiplies widget-supplied w*h*4 unchecked
trigger: A widget calls getImageData with huge width and height.
effect: Overflow panics in debug; in release it wraps, passes the length check and loops w*h times on the widget runtime thread (hang).
fix: checked_mul for w*h*4 and cap w*h at MAX_PIXELS; cap put_image's w*h the same way.

title: WidgetEntry::pressed sticks when the release never reaches the widget, turning later hovers into drags
trigger: Press and hold the mouse on a widget, scroll the history with the wheel (or let the widget restart) so its input layer is no longer under the pointer, release, then move the mouse over the widget again.
effect: The mouse-up listener is only registered while the widget's input layer is painted, and nothing clears `pressed` on hide, stop or restart. The next moves over the widget are sent as Pointer action 1 (a drag with the old button) instead of Hover, and the new runtime gets a release for a press it never saw, until the next full click.
fix: Hold the press in the live runtime state (`Live::press: Option<Press>`) so a stop or restart drops it, clear it in hide_widgets, and end it on a window-level mouse-up rather than the layer's.

title: Widgets start at the main window's scale even in a chat window on another display
trigger: Put the main window on a 1x display and a chat window on a 2x (Retina) display; open a widget message in the chat window.
effect: WidgetsUi::scale is written only by the main window's render (app_render/mod.rs), so start_widget picks the main window's device-pixel ratio for every widget: a widget in the chat window on the 2x display is rendered at 1x and drawn blurry (or at 2x and wasted memory the other way round). If the main window never drew (started hidden to the tray), every widget starts at the 2x default.
fix: Keep the scale per window (in Passes, written by each window's frame start) and start a widget at the scale of the window it is shown in.

title: New widget content keeps the old content's frame and height, so a new runtime that fails shows the old picture as 'stopped'
trigger: A bot edits a widget message to new HTML that fails to start (or crashes before its first frame) while the message is on screen.
effect: The identity change resets runtime, lifecycle, crashes and polled by hand but keeps frame and height. The Failed event then finds entry.frame set and records Lifecycle::Stopped, so the bubble keeps drawing the previous content's last frame with the stopped state instead of the failure; poll also carries over.
fix: On an identity change replace the entry's content-bound part whole (frame, height from the stored value, poll, live runtime), e.g. `entry.content = ContentState::new(identity)`.

title: Widget query tokens restart with every OnScreen while their answers queue in the account's Session, so an old answer can match a new query
trigger: Tap a widget control that sends a query to its bot (slow bot); before the answer, switch to another account; switch back and tap the same widget again before the old query is answered.
effect: WidgetsUi::last_query is reset to 0 by the account switch (OnScreen), but the pending getWidgetQueryAnswer belongs to the account's Session, which survives in the background and appends its answer to bots.widget_answers. After switching back the new runtime asks again with token 1; a late answer to the old token 1 for the same WidgetKey is delivered to the new query.
fix: Make query tokens process-wide (a static counter) or tag them with the ScreenEpoch, so a token is never issued twice for one account session.

title: A public data poll that is never answered leaves the widget in Poll::Asking for good
trigger: Watch a widget with public data; lose the connection or have TDLib drop the pending getWidgetPublicData without an answer (client restart).
effect: Poll::Asking is left only by a WidgetAnswer::PublicData. The error answer exists (bots/widgets.rs), but a request that is dropped with no answer leaves the entry asking, and schedule_widget_polls never polls it again until the entry is pruned or the screen is replaced; the widget's live data stops updating.
fix: Give Asking a deadline (`Asking { since: Instant }`) after which it returns to Due, or tie it to the request id the driver returns so a dropped request ends it.

title: Bridge req_ids are cut to 64 chars, so the reply carries a req_id the page never sent
trigger: Open a mini app whose SDK uses request ids longer than 64 characters, and have it call readTextFromClipboard or invokeCustomMethod.
effect: clipboard_text_received / custom_method_invoked come back with the truncated req_id; the page matches replies by req_id, so its promise never settles and the action looks hung.
fix: Refuse an over-long req_id outright (BadArguments with a failure reply) instead of truncating it, so the answer always carries the id that asked.

title: A refused popup or custom-method request gets no reply event, so the page waits forever
trigger: A mini app calls showPopup with a 300-char message or 4 buttons, or invokeCustomMethod with params over 16 KB.
effect: parse_event returns Err(BadArguments) and spawn_mini_app_window drops it silently (`if let Ok(parsed)`); the page never gets popup_closed / custom_method_invoked with an error and its callback never fires.
fix: Make bad arguments of request-style events produce the bridge's failure reply (popup_closed with no button, custom_method_invoked with an error and the req_id) like `refusal` does for unsupported ones.
